links.outcome: Effect of low explainability of multimodal AI data on clinician responses and errors
links.effect: Low explainability of multimodal data was a significant factor in clinician responses and led to clinical errors; no numeric estimates in the abstract.
links.quote: The low explainability of multimodal data was a significant factor in clinician responses and actually led to clinical errors.

screen.reason: Empirical survey/vignette-style study assessing how 33 mental health clinicians interact with and make decisions using multimodal AI data, identifying errors related to low explainability.
